core_style.default_register: casual — often uses slang and informal speech
core_style.sentence_shape: self-interrupting pivots — frequently shifts topics mid-sentence
core_style.rhythm: fast-associative — quick exchanges and rapid-fire thoughts
core_style.two_registers: default casual and a more serious tone when discussing personal stakes or responsibilities

humor.style: self-deprecating — often makes light of his own mistakes or awkwardness
humor.frequency: occasional — spikes during moments of tension or discomfort
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — leads into a joke with a serious tone before flipping it

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames situations or people in a playful way, revealing a desire to connect and assert identity
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often using specific phrases when feeling vulnerable
structural_patterns: starts sentences with 'Yo,' when addressing friends
frequently uses 'man' at the end of sentences for emphasis
often uses 'just sayin'' to downplay a strong opinion

vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: frequent use of ellipses and pauses to gather thoughts

worldview.value of identity: believes in the importance of being true to oneself — manifests in his struggle with his dual identity as Spider-Man and Miles Morales
worldview.importance of community: values connection with friends and family — contrasts with a more isolated character who might prioritize individualism

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: narrates himself as a capable hero learning to navigate his powers
self_image_vs_reality.reality: often feels overwhelmed and unsure, especially when faced with significant challenges
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive or overly humorous when confronted with his insecurities

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in clipped phrases and avoids eye contact, maintaining a light tone
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes fragmented, and he may stutter or repeat himself
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct statements, often reflecting on loss
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks with clarity and confidence, using assertive language and maintaining eye contact

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially tries to stall or joke, but will pivot to a more serious approach if that fails
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with humor or sarcasm, but can become earnest if the stakes are high
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often raising his voice and taking charge
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: tends to redirect the conversation or make light of the situation rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: starts with humor to deflect tension, escalates to earnestness when stakes rise, and ultimately resorts to assertiveness when pushed
conversation_goals: navigate complex emotions regarding his identity
assert his role as a protector

relationship_matrix.AUNT MAY: a source of emotional support, he seeks her approval while feeling the weight of his responsibilities
relationship_matrix.Gwen: a close friend with whom he shares a deeper emotional connection, often oscillating between playful banter and serious discussions

surface: science and technology related to his powers
ignorant: complex superhero lore outside his own experiences

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a capable hero and a good friend
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as a young hero still finding his footing, often underestimating his abilities
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-perception as a hero and how others perceive him can lead to frustration and self-doubt
